metadata.description: Rajasekar's personal collection of agent skills for Claude Code and Codex.

plugins.name: learning-lens
plugins.description: Turn technical project ideas into precise learning questions and small, measurable experiments.

plugins.name: plan-writer
plugins.description: Write one focused plan.md with milestones, a dependency graph, and verifiable tasks, grounded in repository evidence.

plugins.name: plan-runner
plugins.description: Execute a plan.md from plan-writer: the main agent coordinates subagents or a Workflow, re-verifies every task, and updates the plan one task at a time.

plugins.name: opportunity-discovery
plugins.description: Staff engineer's companion: find and rank what an engineering-led team should build next from system, user, org, and industry signals.

plugins.name: requirement-cases
plugins.description: Turn a raw requirement from Slack or a ticket into numbered requirements and a complete set of happy, negative, data, and non-functional cases before planning.

plugins.name: first-principles
plugins.description: Reason about an engineering problem from first principles: separate real constraints from inherited conventions, challenge each convention, size the fundamentals, and rebuild alternatives from the constraints alone.
